name: digital-business-card
description: A backend digital business card: a GraphQL API over NestJS and Prisma

scripts.start:dev: rm -rf dist; nest build --watch & builder=$!; while kill -0 $builder 2>/dev/null; do until [ -f dist/main.js ]; do kill -0 $builder 2>/dev/null || break 2; sleep 0.2; done; node --watch --watch-path=./dist dist/main.js; sleep 0.5; done; exit 1

//overrides: deepmerge-ts is forced to 8.0.2 for GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx (high, stack exhaustion on recursive
object graphs, affecting <8.0.0). @prisma/config@7.10.0 depends on exactly 7.1.5, and `prisma`
is a production dependency here for `migrate deploy`, so the advisory would otherwise ship in
the runtime image: `npm audit --omit=dev` reports three high findings without this entry and
zero with it. npm's own remedy downgrades prisma to 6.x, which Prisma 7 decisions are written
against. Load-bearing, not a leftover — drop it once @prisma/config depends on 8.x itself.
Full reasoning: "On the one overrides entry" in docs/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md.
